question: There were several cities in the Maurya empire. Which of the following cities was located on the southernmost side?
solution:
** **The correct answer is **Brahmagiri **

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• Brahmagiri was the** southernmost city in the Maurya empire.**
 
• It was located in present-day Karnataka.
 
• It was an **important center for trade and commerce in ancient India.**
 
• The** Brahmagiri inscriptions found here provide valuable information about the Mauryan period**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** Rupnath was located in present-day Chhattisgarh **and was an important **center for Buddhism during the Mauryan period.**
 
• **Girnar was located in present-day Gujarat and was known for its religious significance.** It has several Jain and Hindu temples.
 
• **Topra was located in present-day Haryana** and was known for its **Ashokan pillar inscription. It provided valuable information about the Mauryan period.**
